## Body

Why s07 exists: egret's re-pricing (scratch/proxy-survey/ sim.md, report.md) showed the proxy cost MORE than plain Copilot. Cause: on the BYOK route Copilot uses client-side generic tool search, which adds and drops deferred tools, so the tools prefix changes and the whole prompt is re-written at the 1h price. Evidence: usage_record.availableToolCount, and toolTokenCount for token-only changes.
Fix applied (not code): `toolSearch: false` in user-wide ~/.copilot/settings.json, set by far-jackal on Jordan's go at 03:27:46Z on 19 Nov. It can't be set per repo or per seat. Copilot reads settings only at start, so seats need a restart, which costs one whole-prompt write each; restart big seats when they'd cold-wake anyway.
Residuals under toolSearch=false: the first extensions_reload does a token-only flip; session e69a6a28 did a real count flip (44→49) after the setting. Cause still being traced by sailfish.
TTL: keep 1h for everyone. Per-seat TTL loses 6–26% because a 1h marker never upgrades a 5m entry; a perfect-hindsight per-seat policy saves at most ~4%. Nothing gets built in the proxy.
PR #255 (sailfish, coder/232, docs + sim232.py) status at compaction: round 1 is open. Reviewers: antlion (correctness), pony (security; R1 baseline clean), stingray (cost). One refresh commit is pending from sailfish (due ~04:55Z) carrying:
- the after-window data, split by process start;
- F255-001 / PERF255-02: bound the rate fit to END=03:20Z;
- F255-002 / PERF255-01: keep the residual flips in the achievable estimate;
- PERF255-03: split ttl_sim at restarts;
- the e69a6a28 trigger and every remaining flip, priced as residuals.
When the head arrives, send it to all three reviewers for range-diff against c68ac8f7, then pr-freeze, then FINAL to far-jackal.
The fleet-232 worktree's target/ was removed for disk; nobody builds there. Seats to close after merge (F194 procedure): sailfish, antlion, pony, stingray.
